name: Reeling
tagline: Plan social posts, prepare video ads, and manage channel settings in one workspace.
description: Reeling is a social publishing workspace for planning content, preparing AI-assisted captions and video ads, and managing a calendar with per-channel settings. Eligible plans include REST API access and an official open-source MCP server. Available actions depend on each platform's account permissions and approval status; some setup steps may need to be completed with the platform directly.
